shots.focal_element: First a recreated tweet card (Garry Tan praising Perplexity over Google), then a Nike vs lululemon comparison with an OpenAI-style AI logo in a circle between them
on_screen_text: Perplexity is actually just better than Google for clear well cited answers. The quality of results and speed to answer is significantly better.
shots.typography: Tweet: clean neutral sans (Inter-like, low confidence), name semibold, body medium weight, sentence case, normal tracking; status pill text small regular sans in a rounded outlined capsule. Brand logos shown as their own wordmarks.
shots.what_happens: Over VO w86-w105 ('your life is changing forever ... recommend your business or your competitors'), a frosted tweet card on a light grey background fades/sharpens in (social proof for AI search). Around 32.5s it gives way to a split: Nike logo left, AI logo in a glowing circle centre, lululemon right, joined by a thin vertical line to an 'Analyzing.' pill; logos fade from grey to full colour, then a row of six dash segments under each brand fills with red/orange/green scores (Nike scores higher, lululemon only two red) and the pill flips to 'Finished'. From ~36.5s everything except the Nike logo fades out and the Nike logo scales up with motion blur, leading into the zoom-through.
shots.build_rebuild: On a light grey canvas, fade in a blurred-to-sharp tweet card with soft shadow, then cross to a three-column layout (brand logo, centred AI icon in a glass circle, brand logo) with a status pill that toggles 'Analyzing.' to 'Finished' while six rounded dash bars per brand fill left-to-right in red/orange/green, then fade all but the left logo and scale it up with motion blur.

shots.focal_element: Centred two-line kinetic caption, then the Profound logo lockup
shots.typography: Bold/semibold geometric-grotesk sans (Inter-like, low confidence), white on black, lowercase sentence case, normal tracking; first line smaller, second line noticeably larger and heavier; words appear grey then brighten to white. Logo wordmark in medium-weight sans next to a small pixel/checker mark.
shots.what_happens: The zoom through the Nike swoosh ends on black (~39.0s). Words appear one at a time in sync with VO w106-w114 ('And there's absolutely nothing you can do about it'), each entering dim grey and brightening, the second line at a larger size with a slight baseline bounce. At ~42.5s the background lifts to dark charcoal and the caption shrinks slightly; around w115-w116 ('until now') a white shape sweeps across the frame (a mask wipe around a letter-like 'o'), resolving into the white 'Profound' logo lockup on charcoal by ~43.5s, held through w117-w119 ('Because with profound').
shots.build_rebuild: On a black frame, reveal each caption word on its VO word timestamp with opacity 0.4-to-1 and a small upward settle (line 2 at ~1.3x size), then lift the background to charcoal, sweep a white mask shape across, and resolve the centred logo mark plus wordmark.

shots.focal_element: A silver laptop on a dark surface with a translucent dashboard panel floating in front of its screen
shots.typography: Small UI sans (regular/medium) inside the dashboard, title case section headings; mostly too small to read reliably at this scale.
shots.what_happens: Monochrome, moody product shot (likely a 3D render, possibly footage): a laptop under hard window-light shadows shows a white abstract wallpaper; a frosted, semi-transparent Profound dashboard ('Industry Mention Volume' line chart with a 5.6 tooltip) floats in front of the screen and slides/settles into the screen plane over ~44.5-46.5s, becoming the screen content. VO w119-w126 ('profound world-leading software you can track exactly'). The last sampled frame (47.5s) already shows the next shot's caption, so the cut may be soft.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a laptop on a dark table with diagonal shadow gobos, place a frosted-glass dashboard plane in front of the screen and animate its position and rotation to snap flush into the screen over ~2s with ease-out.

shots.focal_element: Centred two-line headline 'Track what people are asking AI about your industry'
on_screen_text: Track what people are asking AI
shots.typography: Semibold sans (Inter-like, low confidence), sentence case, normal tracking, two centred lines of equal size; words start grey and brighten to white karaoke-style.
shots.what_happens: On a dark charcoal gradient background with soft light falloff, the headline is already laid out but words brighten from grey to white in sync with VO w126-w134 ('exactly what people are asking AI about your industry'), fully lit by ~49.5s. In the final frame (~50.0s) a tilted dashboard view ('Nike > Industry Analysis' with a pie chart) has already taken over, so the exit into s049 looks like a fast cut or blur transition.
shots.build_rebuild: Lay out the full headline centred on a dark radial gradient at 40% opacity, then tween each word's opacity to 100% on its VO word start time (karaoke highlight).

shots.focal_element: Perspective-tilted dashboard: pie and line charts, then the 'All models' dropdown opening
shots.typography: UI sans (regular/medium), title case labels, small breadcrumb text; dropdown items medium weight with model icons; date partly blurred by depth of field.
shots.what_happens: A dark dashboard plane tilted diagonally fills the frame with shallow depth of field. A blue pie segment grows and a green line chart draws on (50.5-51.5s), then the camera pans/pushes to the top-right 'All models' selector (~52.0s); the pill gains a golden glowing outline as if clicked and a dropdown opens, its items (All models, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot) staggering in top to bottom. VO w135-w145 ('See a bird's-eye comparison of how every major platform talks').
shots.build_rebuild: Tilt the dashboard in 3D (~-20deg rotateZ with perspective) under a blurred depth of field, grow the pie slice and draw the line chart path, then move the camera to the model selector, add a gold glow ring and stagger the five dropdown items in with 80ms offsets.
